articles.title_en: The Quality-Adjusted Cyclical Price of Labor
articles.title_cn: 质量调整后的劳动周期性价格
articles.abstract_en: We estimate cyclicality in labor’s user cost allowing for cyclical fluctuations in the quality of worker-firm matches and wages that are smoothed within employment matches. To do so, we exploit a match’s long-run wage to control for its quality. Using 1980–2019 National Longitudinal Survey of Youth data, we identify three channels by which recessions affect user cost: they lower the new-hire wage and wages going forward in the match, but they also result in higher subsequent separations. We find that labor’s user cost is highly procyclical, increasing by more than 4% for a 1 percentage point decline in unemployment.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了劳动使用者成本的周期性，同时考虑了工人-企业匹配质量的周期性波动以及在就业匹配内平滑的工资。为此，我们利用匹配的长期工资来控制其质量。使用1980-2019全国青年纵向调查数据，我们识别出衰退影响使用者成本的三个渠道：它们降低了新雇员工资以及匹配中后续的工资，但也导致随后更高的离职率。我们发现劳动的使用者成本具有高度顺周期性，在失业率下降1个百分点时，其增加超过4%。

articles.title_en: Increasing Earnings Inequality: Reconciling Evidence from Survey and Administrative Data
articles.title_cn: 收入不平等加剧：调和来自调查数据与行政数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: Analyses of survey data highlight observable person characteristics, such as education and occupation, as critical factors for rising earnings inequality, while industry has an offsetting effect. In contrast, analysis of administrative data highlights that rising between-firm earnings dispersion and, in turn, between-industry earnings dispersion dominates the rise in earnings inequality. We construct a novel integrated dataset based on CPS micro data linked with LEHD administrative records. We find that most of the rise in earnings inequality is accounted for by rising between-industry inequality. This finding reflects a substantial contribution of increased sorting and segregation of observable person characteristics between industries.
articles.abstract_cn: 对调查数据的分析强调，可观察的个人特征（如教育和职业）是收入不平等加剧的关键因素，而行业则具有抵消效应。相比之下，对行政数据的分析强调，企业间收入离散度的上升，进而行业间收入离散度的上升，主导了收入不平等的加剧。我们构建了一个基于CPS微观数据与LEHD行政记录相链接的新颖综合数据集。我们发现，收入不平等加剧的大部分可由行业间不平等上升来解释。这一发现反映了可观察个人特征在行业间分类和隔离加剧的实质性贡献。

articles.title_en: The Slow Diffusion of Earnings Inequality
articles.title_cn: 收入不平等的缓慢扩散
articles.abstract_en: Rising between-firm pay dispersion accounts for the majority of the dramatic increase in earnings inequality in the United States in the last several decades. This paper shows that a distinct cross-cohort pattern drives this rise: newer cohorts of firms enter more dispersed and stay more dispersed throughout their lives. These cohort patterns suggest a link between changes in firm entry associated with the decline in business dynamism and the rise in earnings inequality. Cohort effects also imply a slow diffusion of inequality: inequality rises as younger and more unequal cohorts of firms replace older and more equal cohorts.
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去几十年中，美国收入不平等的急剧加剧，大部分可由企业间薪酬差距的扩大来解释。本文表明，一种独特的跨队列模式推动了这一上升：较新的企业队列进入时更为分散，并在其整个生命周期中保持更为分散。这些队列模式表明，与商业活力下降相关的企业进入变化与收入不平等上升之间存在联系。队列效应还意味着不平等的缓慢扩散：随着更年轻、更不平等企业队列取代更年长、更平等企业队列，不平等随之上升。

articles.abstract_en: Many Americans continued some forms of social distancing after the pandemic. This phenomenon is stronger among older persons, less educated individuals, and those who interact daily with persons at high risk from infectious diseases. Regression models fit to individual-level data suggest that social distancing lowered labor force participation by 2.4 percentage points in 2022, 1.2 points on an earnings-weighted basis. When combined with simple equilibrium models, our results imply that the social distancing drag on participation reduced US output by $205 billion in 2022, shrank the college wage premium by 2.1 percentage points, and modestly steepened the cross-sectional age-wage profile.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多美国人在疫情后继续采取某些形式的社交距离。这一现象在老年人、受教育程度较低的人群以及每日与传染病高风险人群接触的人群中更为明显。拟合个体层面数据的回归模型表明，社交距离在2022年使劳动力参与率降低了2.4个百分点，按收入加权计算则降低了1.2个百分点。结合简单均衡模型，我们的结果表明，社交距离对参与率的拖累使美国在2022年的产出减少了205十亿美元，使大学工资溢价缩小了2.1个百分点，并适度加剧了截面年龄-工资曲线的陡峭程度。

articles.title_en: Outsourcing, Occupationally Homogeneous Employers, and Wage Inequality in the United States
articles.title_cn: 外包、职业同质化雇主与美国工资不平等
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops measures of the occupational homogeneity of employers as indicators of outsourcing. Findings are threefold. First, wages are strongly related to occupational homogeneity, particularly for workers in low-wage occupations. Second, by some measures, workers—particularly those in higher-wage occupations—saw their employing establishments become more occupationally homogeneous during 2004–19. Third, changes in the occupational homogeneity of workplaces contributed to growing wage inequality among workers over the first part of this period. The growing sorting and segregation of workers by occupation into different employers is an important part of wage inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了雇主职业同质性的衡量指标，作为外包的指示变量。研究发现有三点。第一，工资与职业同质性密切相关，尤其是对于低工资职业的工人。第二，按某些衡量标准，工人——尤其是那些从事较高工资职业的工人——在2004-19期间其所在雇佣机构变得更加职业同质化。第三，工作场所职业同质性的变化促成了这一时期前半段工人之间工资不平等的加剧。工人按职业日益分化并隔离到不同雇主，是工资不平等的重要组成部分。

articles.title_en: Firm Market Power, Worker Mobility, and Wages in the US Labor Market
articles.title_cn: 美国劳动力市场中的企业市场势力、工人流动性与工资
articles.abstract_en: Worker mobility and wages have declined in the United States amid rising employer market power. I propose a theory of the labor market in which a decrease in employer competition, characterized by fewer firms per worker, drives the decline in worker mobility and wages. A finite and decreasing number of employers exert market power by excluding their offers from the outside options of their employees. This reduces the value of workers’ outside options and, consequently, their wages and transitions across employers. I quantify the model to explain the long-run decline in worker mobility and wages and examine its cross-sectional implications.
articles.abstract_cn: 在雇主市场势力上升的背景下，美国的工人流动性和工资均有所下降。我提出一种劳动力市场理论，其中雇主竞争的减弱——表现为每名工人对应的企业数量减少——推动了工人流动性和工资的下降。数量有限且不断减少的雇主通过将自身提供的报价排除在雇员的外部选择之外来施加市场势力。这降低了工人外部选择的价值，进而降低了他们的工资以及跨雇主流动。我对该模型进行量化，以解释工人流动性和工资的长期下降，并考察其横截面含义。

articles.title_en: Monopsony Power in Higher Education: A Tale of Two Tracks
articles.title_cn: 高等教育中的买方垄断势力：两条轨道的叙事
articles.abstract_en: This paper measures the degree of monopsony power in the US higher-education labor market by using school-specific labor demand instruments to directly estimate the residual labor supply curves facing individual universities. The results indicate that schools have significant monopsony power over tenure-track faculty but face perfectly elastic residual labor supply curves for non-tenure-track faculty. There is some evidence for three sources of monopsony power often discussed in the literature—employer concentration, search frictions/job-switching costs, and differentiated jobs. The results also suggest that monopsony over tenure-track faculty may have contributed to the trend toward hiring more non-tenure-track faculty.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过使用学校特定的劳动力需求工具直接估计单个大学面临的剩余劳动力供给曲线，来衡量美国高等教育劳动力市场中买方垄断势力的程度。结果表明，学校对终身轨教师拥有显著的买方垄断势力，但对非终身轨教师面临的剩余劳动力供给曲线是完全弹性的。有一些证据支持文献中经常讨论的三种买方垄断势力来源——雇主集中度、搜索摩擦/工作转换成本以及差异化工作。结果还表明，对终身轨教师的买方垄断可能促成了聘用更多非终身轨教师的趋势。

articles.title_en: The Effect of Minimum Wage Policies on the Wage and Occupational Structure of Establishments
articles.title_cn: 最低工资政策对机构工资和职业结构的影响
articles.abstract_en: Using establishment-level panel data from the Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics program, I estimate the effect of minimum wage increases implemented by 10 states in 2014 and 2015. I show that minimum wage increases lead to wage spillovers within establishments. I find little evidence that minimum wage increases induce establishments to reorganize their occupational mix. Finally, I find that minimum wage increases propagate up the management hierarchy, leading to increased wages for supervisors. Nonetheless, I find that overall wage inequality decreases within establishments after minimum wage increases.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用职业就业与工资统计项目的机构层面面板数据，我估计了10个州在2014和2015实施的最低工资增长的影响。我表明，最低工资增长会导致机构内部的工资溢出。我几乎没有发现最低工资增长促使机构重组其职业构成的证据。最后，我发现最低工资增长会沿管理层级向上传导，导致主管的工资增加。尽管如此，我发现最低工资增长后，机构内部的总体工资不平等下降。
